This '''Quarren Rebel pilot''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. The [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] participated in a number of [[Timeline of galactic history/Legends|historical]] training [[Flight simulator/Legends|simulations]] around the same time as [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]].<ref name="XW" />
